defect: an unsynchronised PLL lock indication controls reset release
rationale: pll_lock_i can change asynchronously to clk_i, so the AND gate can release local_reset_ni at an unsafe edge even though POR release is pipelined.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

mutation.description: Qualified the synchronized POR reset directly with a raw PLL lock status signal.

labels.note: Raw PLL lock gates the reset after conditioning and can cause asynchronous release.
